beats.action: Tom and Olivia are bundled in blankets near a wooden harvest table.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Happy Random Tuesday, Olivia. I bought you a little surprise gift.

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: A gift? Is this guilt for making us miss the parade?

beats.action: Olivia eyes a heavy, awkwardly wrapped box on her lap suspiciously.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: No guilt, just pure Quinnen Williams style explosive romantic energy today.

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: Okay, but why is this box making a heavy rattling sound?

beats.action: Tom leans in closer, looking very proud of his shopping choice.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Because I saw Jalen Thompson wear one and thought of you.

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: Tom, this is a commemorative Sunderland A.F.C. lead-weighted training vest.

beats.action: Olivia holds up the heavy black vest against her floral sweater.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: It is perfect for our cozy winter hikes and fitness goals.

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: I am going to wear this to dinner and ruin the floor.

beats.action: Tom pulls Olivia into a side-hug despite the heavy weighted vest.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: As long as you are cuddling me, I will take structural damage.

dialogue.speaker: Olivia
dialogue.text: Fine, but next Tuesday I am picking the random surprise gift.

music_prompt: Warm lo-fi jazz with soft acoustic guitar strumming and subtle outdoor festival background chatter.
caption: When his 'thoughtful gift' is actually just a scouting report for his fantasy team. 🍂🏈

history_entry.core_joke: Boyfriend buys girlfriend a heavy sports training vest as a romantic gesture.
